The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Authentication ASIM filtering parser for Salesforce Real-Time Event Monitoring
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , endtime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , username_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , targetappname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , srchostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventresultdetails_in: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventresult: string = "*"
    , disabled: bool = false
    , pack: bool = false
) {
    let UserTypeLookup = datatable (UserType: string, TargetUserType: string)[
        "Standard", "Regular",
        "Guest", "Guest",
        "AutomatedProcess", "System",
        "CsnOnly", "Other",
        "CspLitePortal", "Other",
        "CustomerSuccess", "Other",
        "PowerCustomerSuccess", "Other",
        "PowerPartner", "Other",
        "SelfService", "Other"
    ];
    SalesForceRealTimeEventMonitoring_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where
        (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where EventType in (
        "LoginEvent"
        , "LoginAsEvent"
        , "LogoutEvent"
        , "IdentityVerificationEvent"
    )
    // LoginAccessChange is a login access grant, not an impersonation
    | where LoginAsCategory != "LoginAccessChange"
    // No source hostname exists, nothing matches when filtered
    | where array_length(srchostname_has_any) == 0
    | where array_length(targetappname_has_any) == 0
        or "Salesforce" has_any (targetappname_has_any)
    | where array_length(username_has_any) == 0
        or UserNameDetail has_any (username_has_any)
        or DelegatedUsername has_any (username_has_any)
    | project-rename EventOriginalType = EventType
    | extend
        EventType = case(
            EventOriginalType == "LogoutEvent", "Logoff",
            EventOriginalType == "IdentityVerificationEvent"
                and Activity != "Login",
                "Elevate",
            "Logon"
        )
        // Transaction security policy outcome overrides the event status
        , EventResult = case(
            PolicyOutcome in (
                "Block"
                , "MeteringBlock"
                , "TwoFADenied"
                , "TwoFAReportedDenied"
            )
                or PolicyOutcome startswith "Failed",
                "Failure",
            PolicyOutcome in ("TwoFAInitiated", "TwoFAInProgress"), "NA",
            EventOriginalType in ("LoginAsEvent", "LogoutEvent"), "Success",
            Status in ("Success", "Succeeded", "AutomatedSuccess"), "Success",
            isempty(Status) or Status in ("InProgress", "Initiated"), "NA",
            "Failure"
        )
        , EventResultDetails = case(
            PolicyOutcome in ("Block", "MeteringBlock"), "Logon violates policy",
            PolicyOutcome in ("TwoFADenied", "TwoFAReportedDenied"),
                "MFA not satisfied",
            PolicyOutcome startswith "Failed", "Other",
            Status in (
                ""
                , "Success"
                , "Succeeded"
                , "AutomatedSuccess"
                , "InProgress"
                , "Initiated"
            ), "",
            Status in ("Invalid Password", "FailedInvalidPassword"), "Incorrect password",
            Status == "FailedInvalidCode", "Incorrect key",
            Status in (
                "Password Lockout"
                , "User is Frozen"
                , "FailedPasswordLockout"
                , "FailedTooManyAttempts"
            ), "User locked",
            Status == "User is Inactive", "User disabled",
            Status in (
                "Lightning Login required"
                , "Multi-factor required"
                , "Passwordless Login via Passkeys required"
            ), "MFA not satisfied",
            Status in (
                "Failed: Not approved"
                , "Failed: Not approved for access"
                , "No community access"
                , "Restricted IP"
                , "Restricted Time"
                , "Username-Password Flow Disabled"
            ), "Logon violates policy",
            "Other"
        )
    | where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in (eventtype_in)
    | where eventresult == "*" or EventResult == eventresult
    | where array_length(eventresultdetails_in) == 0
        or EventResultDetails in (eventresultdetails_in)
    // IdentityVerificationEvent stores SourceIp as 32 hex chars (IPv6 / IPv4-mapped)
    | extend _SrcIpAddr = case(
        isnotnull(parse_ipv4(SourceIp)) or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(SourceIp)), SourceIp,
        strlen(SourceIp) == 32 and SourceIp startswith "00000000000000000000ffff",
            format_ipv4(tolong(strcat("0x", substring(SourceIp, 24, 8)))),
        strlen(SourceIp) == 32,
            strcat(
                substring(SourceIp, 0, 4), ":", substring(SourceIp, 4, 4), ":"
                , substring(SourceIp, 8, 4), ":", substring(SourceIp, 12, 4), ":"
                , substring(SourceIp, 16, 4), ":", substring(SourceIp, 20, 4), ":"
                , substring(SourceIp, 24, 4), ":", substring(SourceIp, 28, 4)
            ),
        ""
    )
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(_SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
        or ipv6_is_in_any_range(_SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    // SalesforceDomain is missing in some workspaces
    | extend _DomainFQDN = tostring(parse_url(column_ifexists("SalesforceDomain", "")).Host)
    | extend _DomainHostname = tostring(split(_DomainFQDN, ".")[0])
    | lookup UserTypeLookup on UserType
    | extend
        EventSubType = case(
            EventOriginalType == "LoginAsEvent", "AssumeRole",
            LoginSubType in (
                "OAuth Client Credentials"
                , "OAuth Username-Password"
                , "OAuth JWT Bearer Token"
                , "SOAP API"
            )
                or LoginType in ("Other Apex API", "Remote Access Client"),
                "Service",
            // Connected app logins without a sub type are API integrations
            LoginType == "Remote Access 2.0"
                and isempty(LoginSubType)
                and Application !in ("", "Browser", "N/A"),
                "Service",
            EventOriginalType == "LogoutEvent", "",
            "Interactive"
        )
        , LogonMethod = case(
            EventOriginalType == "LoginEvent",
                case(
                    LoginSubType == "OAuth Client Credentials", "Service Principal",
                    AuthMethodReference has "multipleauthn"
                        or LoginSubType == "OAuth OTP Login",
                        "Multi factor authentication",
                    AuthMethodReference has_any ("x509", "smartcard")
                        or LoginType == "Certificate-based login",
                        "PKI",
                    LoginType has "Passwordless" or AuthMethodReference has "fido",
                        "Passwordless",
                    LoginSubType in (
                        "UI Username-Password"
                        , "UI Password Reset"
                        , "OAuth Username-Password"
                        , "SOAP API"
                    )
                        or Status == "Invalid Password",
                        "Username & Password",
                    "Other"
                ),
            EventOriginalType == "IdentityVerificationEvent",
                case(
                    Policy startswith "Passwordless", "Passwordless",
                    VerificationMethod == "Password", "Username & Password",
                    "Multi factor authentication"
                ),
            ""
        )
        , LogonProtocol = case(
            LoginType has "SAML", "SAML",
            LoginSubType has "OAuth" or LoginType has "Remote Access", "OAuth",
            LoginSubType has "SOAP" or LoginType == "Other Apex API", "SOAP",
            ""
        )
        , EventOriginalSubType = case(
            EventOriginalType == "LoginEvent", LoginType,
            EventOriginalType == "LoginAsEvent", LoginAsCategory,
            EventOriginalType == "IdentityVerificationEvent", Activity,
            ""
        )
        , ActingAppName = case(
            Application == "Browser", Browser,
            Application !in ("", "N/A"), Application,
            ""
        )
        , ActingAppType = case(
            Application == "Browser" and isnotempty(Browser), "Browser",
            Application !in ("", "N/A", "Browser"), "Other",
            ""
        )
        , SrcDeviceType = case(
            Platform startswith "Android"
                or Platform in ("iOS/Mac", "iPad", "iPhone"),
                "Mobile Device",
            Platform startswith "Windows"
                or Platform in ("Linux", "Mac OSX"),
                "Computer",
            Platform in ("", "Unknown"), "",
            "Other"
        )
        , DvcAction = case(
            PolicyOutcome in ("Block", "MeteringBlock"), "Blocked",
            EventOriginalType != "LoginEvent", "",
            EventResult == "Success", "Allowed",
            EventResult == "Failure", "Blocked",
            ""
        )
        , TargetUrl = case(
            EventOriginalType == "LoginEvent"
                and (isempty(LoginUrl) or LoginUrl startswith "http"),
                LoginUrl,
            EventOriginalType == "LoginEvent", strcat("https://", LoginUrl),
            TargetUrl startswith "http", TargetUrl,
            ""
        )
        , AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack
            , bag_pack(
                "SessionKey", SessionKey
                , "SessionLevel", SessionLevel
                , "LoginHistoryId", LoginHistoryId
                , "LoginType", LoginType
                , "LoginSubType", LoginSubType
                , "LoginGeoId", LoginGeoId
                , "PostalCode", PostalCode
                , "AuthMethodReference", AuthMethodReference
                , "AuthServiceId", AuthServiceId
                , "ApiType", ApiType
                , "ApiVersion", ApiVersion
                , "ClientVersion", ClientVersion
                , "HttpMethod", HttpMethod
                , "CipherSuite", CipherSuite
                , "TlsProtocol", TlsProtocol
                , "ForwardedForIp", ForwardedForIp
                , "Policy", Policy
                , "PolicyId", PolicyId
                , "PolicyOutcome", PolicyOutcome
                , "VerificationMethod", VerificationMethod
                , "EventGroup", EventGroup
                , "RelatedEventIdentifier", RelatedEventIdentifier
            )
            , dynamic({})
        )
    | project-rename
        EventOriginalUid = EventIdentifier
        , EventOriginalResultDetails = Status
        , TargetUserId = UserId
        , TargetUsername = UserNameDetail
        , TargetOriginalUserType = UserType
        , TargetSessionId = LoginKey
        , ActorUsername = DelegatedUsername
        , ActorScopeId = DelegatedOrganizationId
        , SrcDvcOs = Platform
        , SrcGeoCity = City
        , SrcGeoCountry = CountryIso
        , SrcGeoRegion = Subdivision
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(EventDate, TimeGenerated)
        , TargetUsernameType = case(
            isempty(TargetUsername), "",
            TargetUsername has "@", "UPN",
            "Simple"
        )
        , ActorUsernameType = case(
            isempty(ActorUsername), "",
            ActorUsername has "@", "UPN",
            "Simple"
        )
    | project
        TimeGenerated
        , Type
        , EventCount = toint(1)
        , EventStartTime
        , EventEndTime = EventStartTime
        , EventType
        , EventSubType
        , EventResult
        , EventResultDetails
        , EventOriginalResultDetails
        , EventOriginalType
        , EventOriginalSubType
        , EventOriginalUid
        , EventUid = _ItemId
        , EventSeverity = iff(EventResult == "Failure", "Low", "Informational")
        , EventProduct = "Real-Time Event Monitoring"
        , EventVendor = "Salesforce"
        , EventSchema = "Authentication"
        , EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
        , Dvc = coalesce(_DomainFQDN, "Salesforce")
        , DvcFQDN = _DomainFQDN
        , DvcHostname = _DomainHostname
        , DvcDomain = substring(_DomainFQDN, strlen(_DomainHostname) + 1)
        , DvcDomainType = iff(isnotempty(_DomainFQDN), "FQDN", "")
        , DvcAction
        , DvcOriginalAction = PolicyOutcome
        , TargetAppName = "Salesforce"
        , TargetAppType = "SaaS application"
        , Application = "Salesforce"
        , TargetFQDN = _DomainFQDN
        , TargetHostname = _DomainHostname
        , TargetDomain = substring(_DomainFQDN, strlen(_DomainHostname) + 1)
        , TargetDomainType = iff(isnotempty(_DomainFQDN), "FQDN", "")
        , Dst = coalesce(_DomainFQDN, "Salesforce")
        , LogonTarget = coalesce(TargetUrl, "Salesforce")
        , TargetUrl
        , TargetUserId
        , TargetUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(TargetUserId), "SalesforceId", "")
        , TargetUsername
        , TargetUsernameType
        , TargetUserType
        , TargetOriginalUserType
        , TargetSessionId
        , User = coalesce(TargetUsername, TargetUserId)
        , ActorUsername
        , ActorUsernameType
        , ActorScopeId
        , ActingAppName
        , ActingAppType
        , LogonMethod
        , LogonProtocol
        , SrcIpAddr = _SrcIpAddr
        , Src = _SrcIpAddr
        , IpAddr = _SrcIpAddr
        , SrcDvcOs = iff(SrcDvcOs == "Unknown", "", SrcDvcOs)
        , SrcDeviceType
        , SrcGeoCity
        , SrcGeoCountry
        , SrcGeoRegion
        , SrcGeoLatitude = coalesce(LoginLatitude, Latitude)
        , SrcGeoLongitude = coalesce(LoginLongitude, Longitude)
        , AdditionalFields
};
parser(
    starttime = starttime
    , endtime = endtime
    , username_has_any = username_has_any
    , targetappname_has_any = targetappname_has_any
    , srcipaddr_has_any_prefix = srcipaddr_has_any_prefix
    , srchostname_has_any = srchostname_has_any
    , eventtype_in = eventtype_in
    , eventresultdetails_in = eventresultdetails_in
    , eventresult = eventresult
    , disabled = disabled
    , pack = pack
)
